Path 1 fast-pass family coverage; warnings keep the search surface honest.

Path 3 pure weekly candidates must have comparable four-window results.
Path 4 emergent-theme candidates use no manual theme labels and must be observed before judging theme-capture quality.
Path 6 is an explicit 2025/2026 return-max path and must be compared on both short windows.
HK-connect candidates are expected to be evaluated on all five windows.
HK Path4 quality/liquidity momentum expansion candidates must be comparable.
HK Path5 pullback/retest expansion candidates must be comparable.
HK Path6 large-liquid defensive core candidates must be comparable.
HK Path7 barbell expansion candidates must be comparable.
HK Path8 short-window return candidates must cover both 2025/2026 windows.
